events.description: During mandatory account-level knowledge synchronization, commit metadata incidentally exposed prohibited prior-generation-specific text not requested for R049.
events.mitigation: The incidental text was quarantined and not used to choose, name, source, tolerance-set, quotient, rank or evaluate any R049 holdout row or Block-B pressure.

training_source_overlap_pre_freeze_audit.attack_performed: A blindness-preserving source-token/repository lookup route was attempted, but the available GitHub code-search backend reported incomplete results. Absence of a hit was therefore not treated as proof of non-reuse.
training_source_overlap_pre_freeze_audit.frozen_postcondition: If a later post-freeze provenance-only audit establishes that an eligible R049 source/protocol was used in the earlier construction surface, this frozen generation is marked ineligible and a NEW holdout generation must be built. The frozen protocol/tolerance/quotient/eligibility fields are never mutated in response.
training_source_overlap_pre_freeze_audit.why_no_deeper_pre_freeze_scan: Reading prior exact protocol/tolerance rows to prove non-reuse would itself violate the candidate-blind construction rule.
